title: Mirror Garden Sorceress
description: A woman in a mirrored disco-ball style bodysuit covered in flowers and vines stands dramatically on broken stone stairs, one arm raised holding a small mirror. She wears a flower crown and is surrounded by floating silver apples, draped fabrics, birds, and a large framed painting of an enchanted forest.
prompt: A dramatic surreal scene featuring a woman wearing a full-body mirrored disco ball suit adorned with colorful flowers and vines, standing on broken mossy stone stairs. She has a flower crown and raises one hand holding a small ornate mirror. Floating metallic silver apples, white draped fabric, two birds in flight, a large golden framed painting of a glowing forest path, and ancient stone ruins fill the dark starry background with dramatic god rays from above.
